name: Busa Finance
description: Busa Finance: a review workspace for a three-statement financial model — the current model snapshot (company/currency/periods/workbook), its model-quality check queue (balance-sheet ties, cash roll-forward, formula reviews), and sanitized settings

agentPrompts.label: Build a new financial model
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-finance` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then build a three-statement starter model for the company I describe and load the result into this workspace. Never invent forecast figures beyond the deterministic demo data or numbers you actually read from a real workbook.

agentPrompts.label: What needs my review right now?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-finance` skill in this folder, then summarize the current model's KPIs (revenue CAGR, ending cash, free cash flow, balance check) and list the model-quality checks still needing review, grouped by severity.

agentPrompts.label: Execute my approved review decisions
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-finance` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run the decision-execution step for every check I have approved, and report which checks are now ready for the next step. This performs no external side effect — no export, filing, or transmission to investors or a source-of-truth system.
